stem.text: The graph shows the effect of an enzyme on a reaction.

stem.alt: Energy of system against time graph with a substrate level, a transition state peak, two labelled curves X and Y, a level Z between the start and end, and product labelled at the end.

stem.text: Which row identifies X, Y and Z?

A.text: catalysed reaction; uncatalysed reaction; energy lost by product

B.text: catalysed reaction; uncatalysed reaction; overall energy lost during reaction

C.text: uncatalysed reaction; catalysed reaction; energy gained by product

D.text: uncatalysed reaction; catalysed reaction; overall energy released during reaction
